raw_segments.text: In Warsaw, there was a bank and anyone comes and stakes against it.
Podvysotsky comes, sees a thousand gold pieces, stakes against the bank.
The banker says, Paney Podvysotsky, are you laying down the gold or must we trust your
To my honor, Paney, says Podvysotsky, so much the better.
Take it, Paney, says the banker, and pulling out the drawer he gives him a million.
Take it, Paney, this is your gain.
There was a million in the bank.
I didn't know that, says Podvysotsky.
Paney Podvysotsky, said the banker, you pledged your honor and we pledged ours.
